# Context*

> **Kind:** context · **Registry:** host · **Folder:** [`src/renderer/context/`](../folders/src-renderer-context.md)
> **Source:** [`src/renderer/context/context.h`](../../../src/renderer/context/context.h), [`src/renderer/context/context.cpp`](../../../src/renderer/context/context.cpp)

## Summary

Pointer to the renderer's Vulkan/OpenXR Context (VRContext, Windu, Instance, Device + VMA, Transfer, Compute, Swapchain, view descriptor layout, frame index).

## Description

Emplaced as reg.ctx().emplace<Context*>(this) in the Context constructor (inside the Renderer constructor), after every member is built and before VRContext::init. The Context object is a member of Renderer, so the pointer is valid from Renderer construction until Renderer destruction; it is never erased from the context. Systems that need GPU access (TerrainSys, InputSys, ModelManager, loadGLTF) fetch it with *reg.ctx().get<Context*>(). Members are constructed in order vr, win, instance, device, transfer, compute, swap. frame_index cycles 0..NUM_FRAMES-1 (NUM_FRAMES = 3) and is advanced by Renderer::prepare.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `vr` | `VRContext` |  | OpenXR instance/session/space/per-eye swapchains; enabled() false when vr_mode is 0 or no runtime/headset. |
| `win` | `Windu` |  | SDL2 window and VkSurfaceKHR. |
| `instance` | `Instance` |  | vk::Instance (API 1.1 or what OpenXR requires), debug messenger in debug builds. |
| `device` | `Device` |  | Physical/logical device, queues (all on the graphics family), VmaAllocator. |
| `transfer` | `Transfer` |  | Upload command buffer, staging buffers, createImage/createBuffer. |
| `compute` | `Compute` |  | Ring of NUM_FRAMES compute command buffers. |
| `swap` | `Swapchain` |  | Desktop swapchain, images and views. |
| `view_layout` | `vk::DescriptorSetLayout` |  | Set 0 of every scene pipeline: one uniform buffer (ViewUBO), vertex + fragment. |
| `frame_index` | `uint32_t` | 0 | Current frame in flight, 0..NUM_FRAMES-1. |

## Side effects per system

- **[ModelManager](../systems/ModelManager.md)**
  - reads glTF/GLB files
  - records uploads in the transfer command buffer
  - logs load info/warnings/errors
- **[TerrainSys](../systems/TerrainSys.md)**
  - creates indirect, staging, lookup buffers, descriptor pool/layouts and the marching cubes compute pipeline
  - reads ./resources/mclookup.bin (throws if not 4096 bytes) and ./resources/shaders/marchingcubes.comp.glsl.spv
  - records updateBuffer, barriers, dispatches into the compute command buffer
  - allocates a 3 MiB GPU vertex buffer and a descriptor set per new slot
  - blocks until the GPU is idle
